thread:
Maya R: noticing a spike of 429s from multiple customers beginning ~15:24 UTC, seems tied to limiter config change pushed at 15:19. Customers report "rate limit exceeded" and prolonged retries causing billing anomalies.

Support: flagged 4 customers in high-touch list, all saw ~6-9 minutes of failures; one embedded partner reports degraded SSE streaming as well.

Eli P: I pulled the deploy log: infra/limiter-service v2.3.1 was rolled with new param `burst_window_ms: 120000` — that doubles the burst retention period. Intended to smooth throughput but looks like it allowed one noisy tenant to soak tokens for longer.

Ops-Oncall-Bot: Incident created INC-5391. Paging oncall.

Maya R: adding immediate action items: 1) set `burst_window_ms` back to 5000 2) enable per-tenant hard cap 3) open firewall rule to temporarily limit offending IPs if still spamming.

Nia J: reproducing with load harness. With burst_window_ms=120000 a single client doing 150 rps for 45s drives shared pool consumption > 70% for 2m, yielding 429s for other tenants. With 5s window it's contained.

SRE-Tooling: logs show token accounting drift: token-lease cleanup task runs every 60s, so long windows cause lease overlap and double-counting when tasks are restarted.

Eli P: good catch. Looks like when limiter process restarts it reclaims leases without checking active_buckets map -> leak. Need fix in reclaim logic.

Maya R: mitigation plan enacted: revert config, restart limiter instances gracefully (drain), and deploy hotfix to ensure idempotent lease reclaim.

DeployBot: infra-deploy started: revert-burst-window (id: dpl-9044) by Maya R

Support: customer comms drafted: apology, timeline, note of compensation offer for affected invoices. Waiting for SRE confirm before sending.

Eli P: opened PR #812: limiter: ensure reclaim checks active_buckets before releasing leases + unit tests covering restart scenarios.

Nia J: adding synthetic e2e: simulate 20 tenants, one noisy burst, verify no tenant sees >5% error rate for 60s.

Maya R: please also add metric: "token_lease_reclaims_unchecked" and alert if >0 in 10m window.

Ops-Oncall-Bot: INC-5391 mitigated at 15:34 UTC. Postmortem due in 72h.

Finance: Customer compensation request noted; will coordinate credits once root cause confirmed.

Support: customer update posted: 429s stopped after 15:34, thanked team.

Maya R: follow-ups: schedule rollback playbook review, add mandatory canary stake for limiter config changes, and add circuit-breaker to block any single tenant consuming >50% of pool for >30s. We'll keep this thread for postmortem attachments.

SRE-Tooling: reminder: scrub API keys from attached logs before posting externally. 

Maya R: thanks all — good catch on the reclaim race; looks like a combination of aggressive burst window + restart race. We'll ensure tests and rollout guardrails are in place.
